content.text: What Are Projects
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: What Are Projects

content.text: Projects are self-contained workspaces that bring together your documents, custom instructions, and chat history in one organized place. Each project includes a 200K context window (equivalent to a 500-page book) so you can upload substantial amounts of relevant content.
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: Projects are self-contained workspaces that bring together your documents, custom instructions, and chat history in one organized place. Each project includes a 200K context window (equivalent to a 500-page book) so you can upload substantial amounts of relevant content.

content.text: Why Use Projects?
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: Why Use Projects?

content.text: Persistent context
: Claude remembers your project knowledge across all conversations
Custom instructions
: Tailor Claude's responses for specific roles or tasks
Collaboration
: Share projects with team members (Team plan)
Organization
: Keep related work together and build on previous insights
Setting Up Your First Project
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: Setting Up Your First Project

content.text: 1. Create the Project
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: 1. Create the Project

content.text: Click on “Projects” and select "New Project"
Give it a descriptive name and brief description
2. Choose Visibility
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: 2. Choose Visibility

content.text: Private
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: Private

content.text: : Only you and invited members can access
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: : Only you and invited members can access

content.text: Best for: Personal work, sensitive information, draft projects
Share with organization
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: Share with organization

content.text: : Everyone in your company can view and use
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: : Everyone in your company can view and use

content.text: (only available on Team and Enterprise plans)
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: (only available on Team and Enterprise plans)

content.text: Best for: Company-wide resources, shared templates, team collaboration
Set Custom Project Instructions
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: Set Custom Project Instructions

content.text: Project instructions tell Claude how to behave within your project. Think of them as your project's "personality" and working style.
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: Project instructions tell Claude how to behave within your project. Think of them as your project's "personality" and working style.

content.text: Examples of effective custom instructions
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: Examples of effective custom instructions

content.text: "Act as a senior business strategist focused on B2B SaaS companies"
"Use our company's writing style: conversational, direct, and action-oriented"
"When analyzing data, always provide three specific recommendations"
"Reference our Master Prompt context when making business decisions"
Best practice
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: Best practice

content.text: : Be specific about tone, role, and output format you want Claude to maintain throughout the project.
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: : Be specific about tone, role, and output format you want Claude to maintain throughout the project.

content.text: Adding to Project Knowledge
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: Adding to Project Knowledge

content.text: There are two ways to add knowledge to your projects:
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: There are two ways to add knowledge to your projects:

content.text: 1. Click "+" in the Project Knowledge section to upload documents or add text content
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: 1. Click "+" in the Project Knowledge section to upload documents or add text content

content.text: You can also add content from connected apps such as Google Drive.
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: You can also add content from connected apps such as Google Drive.

content.text: 🚨 The Google Drive connection is only available in private projects!
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: 🚨 The Google Drive connection is only available in private projects!

content.text: 2. Copy Artifacts to the Project
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: 2. Copy Artifacts to the Project

content.text: If you come across an artifact that you want Claude to take into consideration going forward, click the downward-facing arrow at the top-right of the artifact and select “Copy to project.”
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: If you come across an artifact that you want Claude to take into consideration going forward, click the downward-facing arrow at the top-right of the artifact and select “Copy to project.”

content.text: This instantly saves that artifact to this project’s “knowledge,” which means the AI will draw on it for all future conversations.
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: This instantly saves that artifact to this project’s “knowledge,” which means the AI will draw on it for all future conversations.

content.text: Sharing Chats Within Projects
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: Sharing Chats Within Projects

content.text: Chats are private by default, even within shared Projects. To share a specific chat or message, click the arrow in the upper right corner of the chat, then select "Share & Copy Link" to generate a shareable link.
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: Chats are private by default, even within shared Projects. To share a specific chat or message, click the arrow in the upper right corner of the chat, then select "Share & Copy Link" to generate a shareable link.

content.text: 🚨 Chats that use an integration (e.g., Google Drive) can’t be shared!
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: 🚨 Chats that use an integration (e.g., Google Drive) can’t be shared!

content.text: Update Shared Chats:
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: Update Shared Chats:

content.text: If you want to include new messages in a previously shared chat snapshot, use the "Update snapshot" option in the Share menu to keep the shared content current.
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: If you want to include new messages in a previously shared chat snapshot, use the "Update snapshot" option in the Share menu to keep the shared content current.

content.text: Unshare Chats:
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: Unshare Chats:

content.text: To revoke access, change the chat’s visibility from "Shared" to "Private" in the Share menu, disabling the direct link.
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: To revoke access, change the chat’s visibility from "Shared" to "Private" in the Share menu, disabling the direct link.
